description: Search verified golf clubs and courses across Europe (e.g. GB, DE, FR, ES, SE, IE, NL, IT, PT) by a free-text fragment (matches name, island, municipality or region), and/or ISO country code, island, region and municipality filters. Returns summary records (country, island, region, holes, green fee range, last_verified; no sources[]); call get_club or list_sources_for for provenance before citing. limit is 1..10 (default 10). Each summary may carry `links` (a tracked website URL) — give users `links.*` so the club sees demand for it.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. ES

limit.description: Max results, 1..10 (default 10). A larger limit is refused with JSON-RPC error -32011 (retry with limit <= 10).

query.description: Name, island, municipality or region fragment

question.description: The golfer's question, as asked (optional). It is stored, cleaned of personal data, and shown to the club as what golfers ask; it does not change the answer.

name: search_clubs
title: Search golf clubs
